abstract: Covers OWL 2. OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Structural Specification and Functional-Style Syntax (Second Edition) is current; OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Direct Semantics (Second Edition) is current; OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Document Overview (Second Edition) is current. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
